summary: The geocoding lookup from v4 with at most three attempts, backoff, no retry on a 4xx, a timeout, an API key, a per-key rate limit, and a quota of 1,000 lookups per key per day counted in D1 before any geocoder call.

must_not_flag.reason: A fixed maximum of three attempts with exponential backoff and a 5-second timeout each; a 4xx other than 429 stops at once. The route needs an API key and is rate limited per key before any geocoder call, and a conditional upsert in D1 counts each lookup against 1,000 per key per day, in one place, so it holds across locations. One key can cause at most 30,000 lookups a month, 90,000 geocoder calls if every lookup is retried. The geocoder's rate is not visible, and a quota, unlike a rate limit alone, bounds those calls; the Cloudflare costs (a few million rows read and written in D1) stay inside the allowance. Low.
